title: 970,000 Medi-Cal Members Affected by Paradigm Healthcare Data Breach
description: Paradigm Healthcare Services experienced a data breach detected in October 2025 affecting over 970,000 Medi-Cal members. The breach involved unauthorized access to files containing protected health information such as names, dates of birth, gender, and Medi-Cal member identification numbers. Notification to affected individuals was delayed until September 2026, nearly 11 months after detection. Paradigm took systems offline, involved law enforcement, and engaged incident response experts. There is no evidence provided that the stolen information has been used for fraud or identity theft. Details about the attack vector, threat actor, or data exfiltration remain undisclosed.
aiSummary: In October 2025, Paradigm Healthcare Services detected unauthorized access to its local network impacting over 970,000 Medi-Cal members. The compromised data included personal identifiers and Medi-Cal member IDs but did not affect Paradigm's Student Health Network platform. The breach was reported to the US Department of Health and Human Services, with notification letters sent in September 2026. Paradigm responded by taking affected systems offline, notifying law enforcement, and hiring external incident response teams. The company has not disclosed the attack method, threat actor identity, or confirmed data exfiltration. No evidence of misuse of the compromised data has been reported.
aiImpact: The breach exposed protected health information of approximately 970,000 Medi-Cal members, including names, dates of birth, gender, and member identification numbers. Such data exposure can increase risks of identity theft and privacy violations. However, Paradigm states there is no evidence that the information has been used for fraud or identity theft. The breach may impact patient trust and regulatory compliance obligations. No direct evidence of operational disruption or further exploitation has been provided.
